title: On a conjecture of Goldmakher
summary: We construct a $1$-bounded completely multiplicative function $f$ whose logarithmically-averaged partial sums satisfy $$ \limsup_{x \rightarrow \infty} \frac{\left|\sum_{n \leq x} \frac{f(n)}{n}\right|}{1+\exp\left(\sum_{p \leq x} \frac{\text{Re}(f(p))}{p}\right)} = \infty. $$ This disproves a conjecture of Goldmakher from 2009.
